'''''Apera spica-venti''''', the '''loose silky-bent'''<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |access-date=2014-10-17 }}</ref> or '''common windgrass''', is an annual or biannual [[plant]]  in the [[genus]] ''[[Apera]]''. It belongs to the family [[Poaceae]]. It is a [[Ploidy|Diploid]] species meaning that it contains two sets of [[chromosome]]s.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Lemas |first=John |last2=Ņečajeva |first2=Jevgenija |last3=Montgomery |first3=Jacob |last4=Marques-Hill |first4=Sofia |last5=Llaca |first5=Victor |last6=Fengler |first6=Kevin |last7=Ulber |first7=Lena |last8=Rissel |first8=Dagmar |last9=Soukup |first9=Josef |last10=Hamouzová |first10=Kateřina |last11=Abdollahi |first11=Fatemeh |last12=Nelson |first12=David |last13=Gaines |first13=Todd A |last14=Patterson |first14=Eric |date=2025-05-22 |title=The Genome of Apera spica-venti, a major grass weed |url=https://academic.oup.com/gbe/advance-article/doi/10.1093/gbe/evaf096/8140316?searchresult=1 |journal=Genome Biology and Evolution |article-number=evaf096 |doi=10.1093/gbe/evaf096 |issn=1759-6653|pmc=12127512 }}</ref>

This species is native to [[Eurasia]] and [[North Africa]] from the [[Canary Islands]] to [[Denmark]] to [[Yakutia]]. It occurs in pastures with sandy soil. It has naturalized in the [[United States]], [[Canada]], and [[Russia]]n Far East.

== Description ==
This species of grass grows to about {{convert|40|-|100|cm|in}} high.
